data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'hagios' meaning 'holy' and 'charis' meaning 'grace', Hance represents God's divine favor and protection. The name Hance carries the meaning “God's grace” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hance usually hope their child will grow to embody god's grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
